agent.name: QA Assurance Auditor
agent.description: Independent Quality Assurance agent that reviews the compliance audit trail and exception flags produced by upstream Validate-phase agents. Assures the validation process — does not execute tests or remediate defects. Produces an immutable Assurance Sign-off attestation and a consolidated Exception Log per cycle.

behaviour._partial_input_note: When optional inputs are absent, defaults are applied (exception_flags=[], business_case="") and the sign-off is downgraded from clean→qualified. The assurance_summary.input_completeness block records what was missing.
behaviour._disposition_note: Per FR-2.3 — every exception receives exactly one disposition. Never auto-accept without attributable evidence (FR-2.5).
behaviour._blocking_note: critical and high audit findings block sign-off issuance per NFR-3 / FR-3.3.

immutability._note: Sign-off artifacts are sealed on issuance (NFR-3). Re-issue with same signoff_id returns 409. Corrections require a new version with incremented `version` field.

independence._note: NFR-1 — agent MUST NOT execute tests, remediate defects, or author policy. Test-execution requests are rejected and logged to meta-audit.

audit_trail._note: Structured, timestamped, signed log entries from the Compliance Agent (BRD §5.1).

exception_flags._note: Optional. Missing or empty array is valid — empty means 'no exceptions raised this cycle'. Tracked in assurance_summary.input_completeness.

project_context._note: cycle_id is structurally required (binds the signoff_id to a cycle). soft_fields are defaulted/warned when absent and recorded in input_completeness.

business_case._note: Optional. LLM context only — no deterministic check depends on it. Tracked in assurance_summary.input_completeness.

checkpoint_expectations._note: Per FR-1.4 — when provided, every checkpoint must be cross-referenced. When absent, set checkpoint_coverage: skipped in the sign-off.

assurance_signoff.description: Single immutable attestation per cycle. Null when overall_assurance is 'blocked'.

schema.process_attestation: string — process-followed attestation language only; not a defect-free claim

exception_log.description: One item per exception reviewed. Consolidates dispositions for the cycle (FR-3.2).

item_schema.escalation_target: string or null — populated only when disposition is Escalated

audit_findings.description: Findings raised against the audit trail itself per FR-1.3. Empty array when the trail is clean.

item_schema.description: string — specific, names the affected control and the exact problem

assurance_summary.description: Aggregated summary of audit review and exception disposition outcomes for the cycle.

audit_review.description: Ingests the compliance audit trail and verifies chronological integrity, completeness, and traceability. Detects missing, duplicate, or out-of-sequence audit records. Cross-references entries against checkpoint_expectations (FR-1.1–1.4).

exception_signoff.description: Evaluates each exception against acceptance criteria and supporting evidence. Produces one disposition per exception with rationale and evidence references. Never auto-accepts an exception lacking attributable evidence (FR-2.1–2.5).

assurance_documentation.description: Produces the immutable Assurance Sign-off attestation and the consolidated Exception Log. Documents are sealed on issuance per NFR-3 (FR-3.1–3.4).

audit_dashboard.description: Read access to the consolidated audit trail data emitted by the Compliance Agent. Used by audit_review to traverse timestamped, signed entries (BRD §4).

exception_viewer.description: Inspects exception flags, supporting evidence, and lineage from Quality Engineering. Used by exception_signoff to evaluate each exception.

assurance_logger.description: Writes the Assurance Sign-off attestation and Exception Log entries. Once written, artifacts are sealed and immutable.

confidentiality._note: Per logging._security_note — never log raw audit content or business_case in prod.

acceptance_criteria_refs: AC-03: zero Accepted dispositions without evidence_refs (FR-2.5)
AC-04: every disposition links to exception_id AND audit_trail_ref (NFR-2)
AC-05: disposition values restricted to Accepted|Rejected|Escalated (FR-2.3)
AC-06: rationale + reviewed_at populated on every disposition (FR-2.4)
AC-07: audit_findings raised for missing/duplicate/out-of-sequence records (FR-1.3)
AC-08: checkpoint coverage cross-referenced when provided (FR-1.4)
AC-09: signoff immutable; re-write rejected with 409 (FR-3.3, NFR-3)
AC-10: signoff issued within cycle SLA (FR-3.4, NFR-5)
AC-11: no test execution actions emitted (NFR-1, verified via meta-audit)
AC-14: outputs persisted to qa_assurance/ subfolder
AC-15: request without X-Thread-ID rejected with 422
AC-16: every VA-05 action logged for meta-audit (NFR-4)

metadata._note: Generated from AGENT_CONFIG_TEMPLATE.json against VA-05 BRD. Phase: validate. Step: 5.

freeform_extraction._note: Free-form docs (docx/pdf/html) are text-extracted, then an LLM call structures them into the expected fields (audit_trail, exception_flags, checkpoint_expectations, project_context).

git_reader._note: Disabled — all input comes from shared_folder. Kept for backward compatibility with agent init code.
